messages:
Carlos Vega: FYI incoming invoice from SkyBridge SB-4432-09-2026 for $12,400. It references PO-ENG-2025-045 which was CANCELLED last year. Invoice PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/skybridge-sb4432-09-2026.pdf — vendor billed to OPS-INFRA instead of ENG-Platform.

invoices-bot: New invoice uploaded: SkyBridge SB-4432-09-2026, amount $12,400. Detected PO: PO-ENG-2025-045 (status: cancelled). Recommended action: HOLD and contact vendor. AP ticket created: AP-8864.

Aisha Mahmood: Marking HOLD. We don't accept invoices tied to cancelled POs. I'll message vendor AP and procurement. Can someone confirm which project/dates this charge covers?

Tom Becker: That looks like the benchmark run we did for the 2-node inference tests on Oct 2-3. Eng asked them to keep it within trial but they ran over the trial limit. Usage logs: `s3://redwood-logs/benchmarks/inference/2026-10/10-02-03.csv`. Should map to ENG-Platform (GL 5602).

Procurement-bot: Found potential open PO: PO-ENG-2026-012 (owner: Procurement). That PO has available balance of $15,000 and is for the correct vendor, but vendor invoice dates do not match the PO line item dates. Procurement recommends vendor reissue invoice referencing PO-ENG-2026-012 with corrected dates.

Carlos Vega: Vendor emailed: "We cannot reissue referencing PO-ENG-2026-012 because original transaction referenced old PO. If payment delayed, a late fee of $250 will be applied." Also attached vendor note: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/2026/skybridge-note-latefee.pdf

Aisha Mahmood: We cannot pay against a cancelled PO. I'll request a corrected invoice or credit memo from SkyBridge. Draft message: "Please either (1) issue corrected invoice referencing PO-ENG-2026-012 with dates Oct 2-3, or (2) issue a credit memo and re-bill against PO-ENG-2026-012. Until then payment on HOLD."

Tom Becker: If vendor pushes late fee, Engineering can approve making the team absorb it if Procurement confirms no vendor negligence. But we need documentation of the trial overage. I've uploaded the benchmark CSV to AP-8864.

Procurement-bot: If vendor refuses to reissue, Procurement suggests one of two paths: (A) create a retrospective PO `PO-ENG-RETRO-2026-011` and route to VP Eng for exception approval, or (B) insist on a credit and re-bill. Procurement prefers credit + re-bill.

Aisha Mahmood: Noted. I'll request credit first. If vendor provides partial credit only, we escalate to VP Eng (Anika) for approval to accept remainder without PO.

invoices-bot: AP-8864 update: vendor_contacted. Vendor requested payment within 5 business days or late fee applies. Added note: "If vendor cannot reissue, route to finance-approvals."

Carlos Vega: Suggested message to vendor sent. Copy: "We require invoices to match an active PO. Please reissue against PO-ENG-2026-012 or issue credit and re-bill. We will not pay against cancelled PO-ENG-2025-045."

Tom Becker: Uploaded usage + support ticket crosswalk to AP-8864: `s3://redwood-logs/benchmarks/inference/2026-10/10-02-03-crosswalk.json`. This proves trial overage.

Aisha Mahmood: Vendor replied offering partial credit of $3,900 and to re-bill $8,500 against a new PO. They will not remove late fee unless paid within 3 days.

Procurement-bot: Partial credit implies disputed quantity. Procurement requests proof of consumed resources and will negotiate. If vendor holds firm, route to Anika for decision on taking partial credit vs dispute.

Carlos Vega: Please log decision timestamps in AP-8864. We should avoid creating a retro PO unless last resort. If we create `PO-ENG-RETRO-2026-011` it must include "retro" description and get VP sign-off.

Aisha Mahmood: I'll keep payment on HOLD and push for full credit or corrected invoice. If vendor insists on partial credit + re-bill, I'll escalate to Anika with the documentation. Setting 4 business day SLA for vendor reply before we escalate.

Tom Becker: Thx. I've CC'd Procurement and Anika on the usage evidence. Will add any vendor correspondence to AP-8864.

Carlos Vega: Closing loop here for now. Will update when AP-8864 moves. If vendor invoices again with cancelled PO, send to Legal. :thumbsup:
